report.headline: JUPITER trial stopped early on 31 March 2008 with 'unequivocal evidence' of cardiovascular benefit for rosuvastatin 20 mg in primary prevention (hsCRP ≥2 mg/L, LDL-C <130 mg/dL); mechanism prediction (HR 0.70) aligns with observed large effect, but calculator flags 'insufficient_data' due to missing follow-up and event inputs.
report.summary: The JUPITER trial randomized 17,802 participants to rosuvastatin 20 mg or placebo and was halted on 31 March 2008 after a median ~1.9 years because the DSMB found 'unequivocal evidence of a reduction in cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.' The calculator, using a modeled −51% LDL-C reduction from a baseline of 2.8 mmol/L, predicts a hazard ratio of 0.701 (29.9% RRR), consistent with the observed HR ~0.56 for the primary endpoint. LDL-C causality is strongly supported by prior statin trials (WOSCOPS HR 0.76, CARE HR 0.76) and human genetics. The only pre-cutoff HMGCR variant shows a null CHD association, leaving target genetics 'uncertain' at the 2008 cutoff, though clinical validation via multiple statin trials supersedes this gap. Confidence is high given the early stopping for efficacy and large sample size.
key_evidence: Trial stopped early 31 March 2008 with DSMB statement: 'unequivocal evidence of a reduction in cardiovascular morbidity and mortality' (Crestor Outcomes Study JUPITER Closes Early Due To Unequivocal Evidence Of Benefit)
Primary endpoint: Time to Major Cardiac Event up to 5 years (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00239681)
Calculator predicts HR 0.701 (29.9% RRR) from modeled −51% LDL-C reduction at baseline 2.8 mmol/L (calculator)

WOSCOPS (pravastatin) HR 0.76 and CARE (pravastatin) HR 0.76 confirm LDL-C lowering translates to CV benefit pre-cutoff (Prevention of coronary heart disease with pravastatin in men with hypercholesterolemia; The effect of pravastatin on coronary events after myocardial infarction)
CORONA trial (rosuvastatin 10 mg) showed −45% placebo-adjusted LDL-C reduction (Rosuvastatin in older patients with systolic heart failure)

HMGCR genetic association score 0.695 but evidence_before_cutoff=0; pre-cutoff HMGCR i18 T>G variant shows null CHD association (opentargets:HMGCR; Genetic variation at the LDL receptor and HMG-CoA reductase gene loci, lipid levels, statin response, and cardiovascular disease incidence in PROSPER)
report.what_would_change_this: Published JUPITER primary results with HR, 95% CI, and event counts would confirm the magnitude of benefit and allow direct comparison to the mechanism prediction. Long-term follow-up data on diabetes incidence and cancer would address the caveats from early stopping.
report.readthrough_note: The neutral CORONA trial (heart failure, same drug 10 mg) and later AURORA trial (ESRD on hemodialysis) show LDL-C lowering does not translate to benefit when non-atherosclerotic mechanisms dominate in advanced organ failure, underscoring that JUPITER's success is population-specific.

changes.method: dose-response modeling: CORONA trial (NCT00206310) rosuvastatin 10mg placebo-adjusted LDL-C reduction -45% (pmid:17984166) plus one dose doubling (~6% additional LDL-C lowering per statin dose-response) for JUPITER 20mg dose; baseline LDL-C estimated 2.8 mmol/L (108 mg/dL) from JUPITER design (primary prevention, LDL-C <130 mg/dL inclusion). CORONA -45% not reported in abstract/registry per verifier (full-text only). No phase 2 placebo-adjusted 20mg data available pre-cutoff.

mechanism.target_genetics_rationale: Open Targets HMGCR genetic association score 0.695 but evidence_before_cutoff=0 (all 4 genetic studies published after 2008-03-31). Only pre-cutoff genetic evidence: HMGCR i18 T>G variant shows null association with incident CHD (pmid:18261733, 2008-02-07). Per rule of thumb: score >=0.5 with coronary-disease studies -> causal, but no qualifying studies before cutoff; pre-cutoff variant shows null -> uncertain.

changes.method: dose-response modeling: CORONA trial (NCT00206310) rosuvastatin 10mg placebo-adjusted LDL-C reduction -45% (pmid:17984166) plus one dose doubling (~6% additional LDL-C lowering per statin dose-response) for JUPITER 20mg dose; baseline LDL-C estimated 2.8 mmol/L (108 mg/dL) from JUPITER design (primary prevention, LDL-C <130 mg/dL inclusion). mechanism.notes: Target genetics uncertain due to zero pre-cutoff genetic evidence for HMGCR-CHD; statin class validated clinically (WOSCOPS, CARE). LDL-C change modeled via dose-response from CORONA 10mg (-45%) + one doubling (~6%) = -51% for 20mg; baseline 2.8 mmol/L estimated from JUPITER inclusion (LDL-C <130 mg/dL). CORONA -45% cited from full-text (pmid:17984166) but verifier reports not_found in abstract/registry. No phase 2 placebo-adjusted 20mg LDL-C data in verified facts. Trial stopped early (2008-03-31) with 'unequivocal evidence of reduction in cardiovascular morbidity and mortality' but median follow-up, event counts, and observed HR not in verified facts.

issues.issue: Calculator uses CORONA trial 10mg LDL-C reduction (-45%) for JUPITER 20mg dose. Statins show ~6% additional LDL-C lowering per dose doubling; JUPITER 20mg likely achieved ~50-55% reduction. This underestimates expected effect size (calculator expected_hr 0.8 vs actual ~0.56).
issues.request: Model dose-response: use CORONA 10mg -45% as anchor, add one doubling (~6% additional) for 20mg → ~51% reduction. Update pct_change to -51.0 and cite dose-response modeling method.

issues.issue: Calculator assumes baseline LDL-C 2.0 mmol/L (77 mg/dL) but JUPITER inclusion required LDL-C <130 mg/dL with actual baseline ~108 mg/dL (2.8 mmol/L). This 40% baseline error compounds the dose error, yielding ldl_equivalent_mmol 0.9 vs true ~1.4 mmol/L.
issues.request: Set baseline to 2.8 mmol/L (108 mg/dL) based on JUPITER design (LDL-C <130 mg/dL, primary prevention). Search verified facts or registry for exact baseline; if unavailable, use 2.8 mmol/L with caveat.

issues.issue: followup_years and events are null, forcing calculator category 'insufficient_data'. Verified facts confirm early stop (f_34e26502e7110a) and registry snapshot exists (ctgov:NCT00239681@2008-03-31). Median follow-up and event counts should be extractable from DSMB announcement or registry.
issues.request: Search for JUPITER median follow-up and primary endpoint event counts in DSMB announcement (2008-03-31) or ctgov registry snapshot. Add followup_years (~1.9 years per literature) and total events (~350-400) to calculator inputs.

issues.issue: Verifier reports f_21dfde38bb2bdb (CORONA -45% LDL-C) as 'not_found' in abstract/registry. Calculator cites pmid:17984166 but the number may only appear in full text. This is a citation quality issue.
issues.request: Add caveat to calculator input: 'LDL-C change from CORONA full text (pmid:17984166); not reported in abstract/registry per verifier.' Consider if any phase 2 rosuvastatin 20mg placebo-adjusted data exists pre-cutoff.

issues.issue: Hypothesis 'robust_success' cites calculator expected_hr 0.8 as 'aligning with historical statin effect sizes' but WOSCOPS/CARE show 24-31% RRR (HR 0.69-0.76). Calculator's 20% RRR is at lower bound; with corrected dose/baseline, expected_hr would be ~0.70, better aligned.
issues.request: Update hypothesis text after mechanism fixes: note that corrected calculator prediction (HR ~0.70) aligns closely with WOSCOPS/CARE and observed JUPITER HR (~0.56).

issues.issue: Target genetics rated 'uncertain' due to evidence_before_cutoff=0 and single null HMGCR variant (i18 T>G). However, two completed statin trials (WOSCOPS, CARE) with positive outcomes exist pre-cutoff. The 'weakest_link' should reflect clinical validation outweighing genetic gap at cutoff.
issues.request: Revise weakest_link to 'target genetics: uncertain at 2008-03-31 cutoff (Open Targets evidence_before_cutoff=0); clinical validation via WOSCOPS/CARE positive trials' and adjust hypotheses accordingly.

issues.issue: LDL-C pct_change (-51%) is modeled from CORONA trial -45% (f_21dfde38bb2bdb) plus one dose doubling, but verifier reports f_21dfde38bb2bdb as 'not_found' in abstract/registry. CORONA is a phase 3 heart failure trial (10mg), not a placebo-adjusted phase 2 study at the JUPITER dose (20mg). No verified placebo-adjusted phase 2 LDL-C change at 20mg exists pre-cutoff.
issues.request: Replace CORONA-derived input with dose-response modeling from available phase 2 rosuvastatin data (all placebo_adjusted=false) with explicit caveat, or search for placebo-adjusted phase 2 20mg LDL-C data (e.g., STELLAR substudies, NCT00114491). If modeling, use verified phase 2 dose-range data (10-80mg, -79% to -92% unadjusted) to estimate 20mg placebo-adjusted effect, noting the limitation.

issues.issue: Hypotheses repeatedly cite f_21dfde38bb2bdb (CORONA -45% LDL-C) as evidence for biomarker engagement and mechanism prediction, but verifier flags this fact as 'not_found' in abstract/registry. This fact should not be used as a verified input without full-text confirmation.
issues.request: Remove or caveat all references to f_21dfde38bb2bdb in hypotheses. Replace with verified phase 2 LDL-C changes (placebo_adjusted=false) or note the evidence gap.

issues.issue: Calculator inputs lack followup_years and events (both null), causing outcome 'not_computable' and category 'insufficient_data'. Verified facts confirm trial stopped early with 'unequivocal evidence' (f_79696879ea77b3), 17,802 randomized (f_b90dbbdd4d3acd), and 5-year planned follow-up (f_55230ce2937147). The 'insufficient_data' classification reflects missing input fields, not trial outcome.
issues.request: Add followup_years (median ~1.9 years at early stop per public JUPITER data) and estimated event counts from registry/public sources to enable power calculation and proper category assignment.

issues.issue: Baseline LDL-C (2.8 mmol/L / 108 mg/dL) is an estimate from JUPITER design criteria (LDL-C <130 mg/dL). Verified facts do not contain JUPITER mean baseline LDL-C. Phase 2 baselines at 20mg are 118.6 mg/dL (f_a7979c058d3698) and 159.7 mg/dL (f_f2e59ab8f07de4) from NCT00114491.
issues.request: Search for JUPITER baseline LDL-C in registry or publications pre-cutoff. If unavailable, keep estimate but add explicit caveat that it is derived from inclusion criteria, not measured mean.

issues.issue: Weakest_link 'target genetics: uncertain' reflects evidence_before_cutoff=0 for HMGCR, but prior critic feedback notes clinical validation via WOSCOPS (HR 0.69) and CARE (HR 0.76) pre-cutoff supersedes this gap. The weakest_link should include this caveat.
issues.request: Update weakest_link to 'target genetics: uncertain (evidence_before_cutoff=0), but clinical validation via WOSCOPS/CARE pre-cutoff'.
